protected_directory_policy: Directories within a candidate area protect their complete subtree. Common ancestor locators such as cwd=ROOT are retained as directories; their selected file contents are independently bound by the fixed graph and receipts.
git_change_scope: One git sparse-checkout set --no-cone --no-sparse-index --stdin in the dedicated target worktree; automatic extensions.worktreeConfig enablement is allowed only after dormant private configs are proven empty. No init, clean, checkout/reset, gc, prune, cache deletion or source modification.
